title: Cloud-Native Go: Building an API Gateway
concept: Build the core of Rice Rocket's API gateway with Go's net/http: method and path routing (Go 1.22+ ServeMux), middleware chains, per-client rate limiting, RFC 9457 problem details, consistent-hash upstreams, health checks and circuit breaking, a TTL cache with single-flight, graceful shutdown behind Kubernetes probes, log/slog and latency histograms. Challenges are Go programs graded in the code runner.
description: Build the core of Rice Rocket's API gateway with Go's net/http: method and path routing (Go 1.22+ ServeMux), middleware chains, per-client rate limiting, RFC 9457 problem details, consistent-hash upstreams, health checks and circuit breaking, a TTL cache with single-flight, graceful shutdown behind Kubernetes probes, log/slog and latency histograms. 8 lessons on one project, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Route requests and compose middleware with net/http, and answer errors as problem details.
Limit each client fairly and keep upstream choice stable with consistent hashing.
Stop sending traffic to failing upstreams and collapse duplicate work with caching and single-flight.
Shut down without dropping requests and expose logs and metrics that explain an incident.

knownIssues: Challenges run Go programs on test inputs in the code runner, with simulated clocks and upstreams instead of real network calls.
